svg.aria-label: Write a policy in the Magistrate Studio: build, review, ship. Then your app asks, Octet signs the answer, and your backend decides.

g.text: Say what you need in plain words, or use the builder and the map.
Read the policy in plain English and approve each line.
Sign it off and hand it to Octet. Once it is linked to your licence, decide() uses it.
Your app asks. Octet signs the answer. Your backend decides.
What are you trying to solve?
Every request: is the device in the EU or the UK?
